dz: 穆斯塔法二世在艾哈迈德二世去世后,在伊斯坦布尔成为了奥斯曼苏丹和伊斯兰教的哈里发. 穆斯塔法统治至1703年退位.
de: Mustafa II becomes the Ottoman sultan and Caliph of Islam in Istanbul on the death of Ahmed II. Mustafa rules until his abdication in 1703.

t: 清朝山西1695年林芬地震造成特大损失并造成至少52000人死亡.
te: The 1695 Linfen earthquake in Shannxi, Qing dynasty causes extreme damage and kills at least 52,000 people.
dz: 清朝山西1695年林芬地震造成特大损失并造成至少52000人死亡.
de: The 1695 Linfen earthquake in Shannxi, Qing dynasty causes extreme damage and kills at least 52,000 people.

t: 法军结束对布鲁塞尔的轰炸.
te: French forces end the bombardment of Brussels.
dz: 法军结束对布鲁塞尔的轰炸.
de: French forces end the bombardment of Brussels.

te: Henry Every perpetrates one of the most profitable pirate raids in history with the capture of the Grand Mughal ship Ga…
dz: Henry Every犯下了历史上最有利可图的海盗袭击行动之一,俘获了"大莫卧儿"(Ganj-i-Sawai)号船. 作为回应,奥兰热布皇帝威胁要结束所有在印度的英国贸易.
de: Henry Every perpetrates one of the most profitable pirate raids in history with the capture of the Grand Mughal ship Ganj-i-Sawai. In response, Emperor Aurangzeb threatens to end all English trading in India.

dz: 宗比是巴西早期前逃亡奴隶多斯·帕尔马雷斯(Quilombo dos Palmares)的最后一位领导人,被葡萄牙班德罗·多明戈斯·豪尔赫·维尔霍(Domingos Jorge Velho)的部队处决.
de: Zumbi, the last of the leaders of Quilombo dos Palmares in early Brazil, is executed by the forces of Portuguese bandeirante Domingos Jorge Velho.
